cities.name: Andorra la Vella
cities.local_food_tip: Try traditional dishes such as 'escudella' (meat stew), 'trinxat' (potato-cabbage mash with bacon), game meat, cheeses and mountain-style specialties — warm, hearty and energizing. 🍲
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌄 Walk through the city center and main shopping street — wake up to mountain views. → 🏛️ Explore historic lanes, churches and old houses. → ☕ Coffee and mountain soup in a local tavern.

Afternoon: 🥾 Short drive or hike to scenic viewpoints around the valley and Pyrenees. → 🍽️ Lunch: escudella or trinxat with cheese. → 🛍️ Shop for mountain crafts or gear.

Sunset: 🌇 Watch sunset from nearby hills or panoramic spots above the city.

Night: 🌃 Enjoy the evening in town — mountain restaurants, souvenirs and relaxed city life under the stars.

ideas: 🌼 Light hikes as snow melts and nature awakens.
☕ Local food and coffee after a morning walk in town.
🚶 Urban strolls with mountain air — perfect post-winter boost.
🏞️ Mountain trails, lakes and summits — just minutes from town.
🌄 Evening views from higher ground: crisp air and long shadows.
🧀 Light mountain meals — cheese, meats and soup after adventures.
🍂 Colorful landscapes and fresh mountain air — ideal for photos.
🥘 Traditional meals in cozy restaurants for that cultural feel.
🏛️ Visit old town areas without the crowds — quiet and authentic.
❄️ Snowy trails and fresh air with Pyrenees views.
🔥 Warm escudella or trinxat after a chilly day — perfect comfort food.
🏙️ Evening strolls through the lit-up town with alpine ambiance.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Buses connect all valley areas — easy access to ski resorts, towns and villages.
🚶 The city center and shopping zones are walkable — no car needed.
🚗 For highland roads — check conditions in winter, especially mountain passes.
🎟️ Look for combined tickets (transport + ski-lift) during the season — cost-effective for day trips.

cities.local_food_tip: Mountain cuisine: meats, game, wild mushrooms, cheeses and potato/cabbage dishes — perfect after skiing or hiking. 🌲🍽️

Afternoon: 🎿 Winter sports (snow season) or alpine walks and lake hikes (summer). → 🍲 Lunch at a mountain lodge with local specialties.

Sunset: 🌄 Sunset from the summits or mountain slopes — golden glow over peaks.

Night: 🔥 Dinner by the fireplace, mountain wine and local cheese — perfect end after active day.
